text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As for souvenirs from our upcoming trip, 
let's see... For Vivlos, definitely some 
cosmetics. And Cheval would probably love 
some sweets!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this playing it a bit too safe? 
Like, it doesn't feel any different from 
usual... Isn't it a bit mundane...?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's right. The one who can pick 
out the most suitable thing for those 
girls is me—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The one who can bring out her brightest 
smiles and make her the happiest... is me, 
her big sister!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I'll do it. For the sake of those kids...!
